notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {2}.
description:
Cast Journey to the Oracle by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand, copying Journey to the Oracle.
Resolve the copy of Journey to the Oracle, putting at least two lands from your hand onto the battlefield and choosing not to discard a card if you control eight or more lands.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.
